method: Original Google v3 CSV/WKT roof footprints and saved original numerical 2023 relative-height observations. No imagery used; no repeated lookup.

models.limitations: Heights are learned numerical estimates at effective 4 m resolution, not a surveyed roof profile or floor census. Confidence is a relative rank, not a probability. Ecuador performance is not established by the Global North evaluation. Use at least 3 m height uncertainty; all imagery unused.
